name: geniro
description: Production-grade Claude Code harness with AI-driven setup, multi-agent skills, and safety hooks. Includes /setup for project-tailored configuration.

instructions_dir.title: Custom instructions directory
instructions_dir.description: Optional. Absolute path to a directory holding your Geniro custom-instruction files (global.md, code-style.md, <skill>.md) when you don't commit .geniro/instructions/ into the repo — e.g. clean fresh-clone or ephemeral environments. For automated or headless environments, prefer setting the GENIRO_INSTRUCTIONS_DIR environment variable. Leave empty to use the in-repo .geniro/instructions/.
